files.installs/bedrock/gamedash-test-run.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# gamedash-managed Minecraft Bedrock server — generated by provision().
# Settings: <ROOT>/installs/bedrock/gamedash-servers/test/server.properties     Who may join: <ROOT>/installs/bedrock/gamedash-servers/test/allowlist.json
CONSOLE="<ROOT>/installs/bedrock/gamedash-servers/test/server.log.console"
: > "$CONSOLE"
cd "<ROOT>/installs/bedrock/gamedash-servers/test" || exit 1
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=.
# The server's console is fed from the file above, so the dashboard can type
# commands into it (say, kick, stop).
exec ./bedrock_server > "<ROOT>/installs/bedrock/gamedash-servers/test/server.log" 2>&1 < <(tail -n0 -F "$CONSOLE")
files.installs/bedrock/gamedash-test-stop.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed graceful stop: "stop" makes the server save the world and quit.
echo "stop" >> "<ROOT>/installs/bedrock/gamedash-servers/test/server.log.console"
i=0
while [ $i -lt 45 ] && ! grep -q "Quit correctly" "<ROOT>/installs/bedrock/gamedash-servers/test/server.log" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done
exit 0
